Recording (screen + face)

Not connected. Trials will not be recorded.
Click the button, then when Chrome asks what to share, pick this tab (Drone Delivery Simulator) and allow the camera. You only do this once per session. Point the webcam at the participant's face and check the preview.

Before you start

1. Put the Apple Watch on the participant and start a Workout (Other) so heart rate is saved every few seconds. Leave it running for the whole session.
2. Check that the watch, phone, and this PC all set their time automatically, so heart rate lines up with the logs.
3. Connect the camera and screen above.
4. Run in this order: Baseline rest → Practice → Trial 1 → Trial 2.
5. Press any button on the controller so the browser detects it (top-right of the flight view).
6. After Trial 2, end the workout on the watch. Heart rate is then in the iPhone Health app for export.

Researcher keys: C status answer correct · N status answer wrong · P pause · Esc end trial early
